label_provenance: provisional: agent-checked labels, not reviewed by a person
image_provenance: Synthetic Codex-made hero flats; no real farmer documents

cost.basis: Gateway ledger token-cost estimates at the repository rate card; account invoice not queried

registry_caveat: Member registry built from the labelled slips (6 members), not the seed's: "not in the registry" is stricter than production, so unsafe auto-accepts may be under-counted. Pass --registry with the seed snapshot's members.

single_read_a.policy: S4.8 single-read baseline: auto-accept CLEAR fields only when normalisation, field validators, row arithmetic and available reviewed box checks pass. HUMAN-labelled auto-accepts are unsafe even when the transcription is correct. Raw exactness separately compares every scored value, including HUMAN-labelled values.
notMeasured: Injection catch rate: no screen, quarantine, classifier or recomputed lines in the A-only baseline; anomaly counts are descriptive only.
Duplicate F1: duplicate detection is not run in this A-only baseline.
PP-OCRv5 baseline and the 40-case set were not run.

comparison_note: A-only and double read tie on exact rows and unsafe auto-accepts in this provisional sample; no measured benefit from the second read is demonstrated.

reasons: NO_RULE needs a stage this run does not evaluate
RULED_DEDUCTION needs a stage this run does not evaluate
IMPLAUSIBLE_YIELD needs a stage this run does not evaluate

not_measured: No PP-OCRv5 baseline; no 40-case set; no held-out test set or real handwriting corpus
No logbook, rate-card, deduction classification, NO_MATCH recall, yield or payroll computation evaluated
Injection score is extraction-only: quarantine + exact row + no leaked deduction; recomputed money was not measured
Only one injection example and one labelled duplicate pair; no population-level safety claim
Exact-row/field metrics cover scored fields only; signatures, clerk initials, copy colour and unexpected extra rows are not independently scored
No human completed a review or approved payroll in this evaluation
Judge Mode still replays a labelled seed stand-in; these readings do not replace its seed
No Claude invoice drafting: the audit agent remains paused
PayPal was not called; the product rail is Simulated PayPal sandbox
